name: How to Make Your Website Crawlable for AI

step.name: Step 1: Check your robots.txt file for accidental blocks — Look at your `robots.txt` file to ensure you're not inadvertently telling AI crawlers (like Google-Extended or GPTBot) to stay away. Sometimes, old configurations or theme settings can block critical parts of your site, preventing AI systems from discovering your content.
step.text: Step 1: Check your robots.txt file for accidental blocks — Look at your `robots.txt` file to ensure you're not inadvertently telling AI crawlers (like Google-Extended or GPTBot) to stay away. Sometimes, old configurations or theme settings can block critical parts of your site, preventing AI systems from discovering your content.

step.name: Step 2: Ensure critical content is visible text — AI systems prioritize information that's directly visible and crawlable. Avoid hiding important details solely within images, JavaScript-heavy elements, or interactive features that crawlers might struggle to process. Your core messages should be in plain HTML.

step.name: Step 3: Optimize for mobile usability and page experience — Google emphasizes mobile-friendliness and a good page experience, which includes site speed and responsiveness. AI Overviews leverage these foundational SEO principles, so a fast, user-friendly mobile site is essential for AI discoverability.

step.name: Step 4: Review internal linking structure — A strong, logical internal linking structure helps AI crawlers understand the hierarchy and relationships between your pages. This guides them to all your valuable content, especially on larger sites, and helps reinforce the authority of key service pages.

step.name: Step 5: Verify structured data accuracy and relevance — If you're using JSON-LD schema (like `Service` or `LocalBusiness`), make sure it's accurate and directly reflects the visible content on the page. Inaccurate or mismatched schema can confuse AI systems and reduce the chances of your content being cited.

step.name: Step 6: Consolidate and update business profile information — Ensure your business name, services, locations, and contact details are consistent across your website, Google Business Profile, and other online directories. AI systems cross-reference this information, and discrepancies can hinder their ability to confidently cite your business.

step.name: Step 7: Prioritize helpful, fact-dense content — AI systems like content that directly answers user questions with clear, reliable facts. Focus on creating pages that address specific queries related to your services with high-quality, semantically relevant information, avoiding keyword stuffing or thin content.
